selection-logic.alt: Four panels of beetles on dark soil. 1, heritable variation: 3 of 10 beetles are dark and 7 light, and coat color is inherited. 2, not all survive: more are born than can live, and birds spot light beetles on dark soil more easily, so 5 light and 1 dark beetle are eaten, leaving 2 dark and 2 light. 3, survivors reproduce: each survivor has offspring of its own color. 4, the next generation: 5 of 10 beetles are dark, 50% instead of 30%. No beetle changed color; the proportions changed. Repeated over many generations, the population evolves.
